name: Re;quartz Reido
source:
Taking place in a different universe from the original Re;quartz, Reido, in turn, takes place in a different world, where the new protagonist, Yuni, belongs to an organization of people with supernatural powers. When he moves from European headquarters to a branch in the Far East, he is attacked by something and dies. Unmask the liars and choose which side of their faces to see while trying to find out who your killer was.

[from [url=http://blyme-yaoi.com/2018/2020/09/12/checklist-bl-games-de-2020/]Blyme Yaoi[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在与原版《Re;quartz》不同的宇宙中，而《Reido》又发生在一个不同的世界，新的主角尤尼属于一个拥有超自然力量的组织。当他从欧洲总部转移到远东分部时，他遭到某种东西的袭击并死亡。揭开骗子的面纱，选择看他们脸的哪一侧，同时找出凶手是谁。

[来自[url=http://blyme-yaoi.com/2018/2020/09/12/checklist-bl-games-de-2020/]Blyme Yaoi[/url]]
